global.name.description: Unique name for this Plum instance (used in logs and internal references)

global.data_dir.description: Directory for persistent data (e.g., bot state, module caches)

global.user.description: System user to drop privileges to after startup

global.group.description: System group to drop privileges to after startup

global.max_open_files.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors (ulimit -n)

servers.description: List of upstream IRC servers to connect to as a proxy

name.description: Unique identifier for this server entry

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the IRC server

port.description: Port number of the IRC server (typically 6667 for plain, 6697 for SSL)

password.description: Password to use when connecting to the IRC server (server auth)

nick.description: Bot nickname to use when connecting (supports %u placeholder for user)

reconnect_delay.description: Seconds to wait before reconnecting (applies if auto_connect=true)

bots.description: List of bot instances to run

name.description: Unique name for the bot instance

server.description: Name of the server (from `servers`) this bot connects through

identify_password.description: Password to send to Nickserv/identify service upon connection (if needed)

channels.description: Channels the bot should auto-join on startup

modules.description: List of bot modules to load

options.description: Key-value options passed to the module

logging.level.description: Global log level (debug, info, warn, error, fatal)

max_age_days.description: Rotate logs older than this many days

station.enabled.description: Enable stationing (IRC operator services like NickServ, ChanServ)

station.services_nick.description: Nickname for the stationing service bot

station.services_user.description: Username for the stationing service bot

station.services_realname.description: Realname for the stationing service bot

station.auth_backend.description: Backend for user/channel authentication (sqlite or ldap)

station.sqlite_db.description: Path to SQLite database for authentication (if auth_backend=sqlite)

station.ldap_base_dn.description: LDAP base DN for user searches

station.ldap_bind_dn.description: Bind DN for authenticating to LDAP
